name: nemotron-voicechat-11b
benchmark_exclusion_reason: The model-card audio is provided by a pinned public Speech checkout rather than the packaged benchmark catalog.

testcases.name: nemotron-voicechat-11b
testcases.expected_response_text: Hi there! How can you? How can I help you today? The sky is blue. That blue color is because of something called Rayleigh scattering.
testcases.notes: Runs the pure native TensorRT/C++ trtmc speak path on the exact public Speech model-card sample. The sample-count and alignment gates establish 196 frame-sized units at 1764 samples each; the C++ lifecycle checks cover session event ordering. Direct session agent text must preserve the Rayleigh-scattering model-card semantics; a separate native trtmc transcribe pass checks self-transcription consistency without requiring preservation of the proper noun.
